Validate Growth Curve Models

Source: R/validate.R
validate_adg.Rd

Compare growth curve models on the valid weight records of each pig, in two ways:

  • k-fold cross-validation: the recorded days of each pig are split into k groups; each group in turn is left out, the curve is fitted on the others and predicts the weights of the left-out days;

  • truncation: the first (late entry) or last (early exit) trim_days days are hidden, ADG is computed again and compared with the ADG from all records of the same model.

validate_adg(
  weight,
  models = c("poly1", "poly2", "poly3", "loess", "gompertz"),
  k = 5,
  trim_days = c(10, 20),
  qc = weight$settings,
  max_pigs = NULL,
  seed = 1,
  verbose = 1,
  cores = 1
)

Arguments

weight

Result of clean_weight().

models

Curve models to compare (values of curve_model).

k

Number of folds. Default 5.

trim_days

Days hidden at the start or the end of the test. Default c(10, 20).

qc

QC settings; stage_range and max_extrap_days are used.

max_pigs

Use a random sample of at most this many pigs. Default NULL: all.

seed

Random seed for the folds.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary and progress, default).

cores

Number of CPU cores. Default 1.

Value

A list of class ppt_validation with

  • summary: one row per model: cv_rmse and cv_mae (kg, weight of the left-out records), and for each truncation (late10, early10, ...) the growth-curve ADG (adg_curve) bias, rmse (g/d) and Spearman rank correlation spearman with the full-data ADG, and how many pigs still get an ADG (n);

  • cv: cross-validation error of every pig and model;

  • truncation: ADG of every pig, model and truncation;

  • settings.
